title: A refused cast in arithmetic reports a second error for the `mixed` it leaves behind.
text: `return $total + (int)$each;` in a method declared `: int` reports `E0225` for the cast and also `E0403`, because the refused cast is typed `mixed` and the sum inherits it. One mistake gives two diagnostics, and the second one points at the whole expression rather than at the cast. Closing this types a refused cast as its target type, the way the `as` its suggestion names would be typed, so the expression around it checks as written; a test pins one diagnostic for that line.
